cn_title: 卡普空称《识质存在》续作有望
subtitle: 新IP的未来
summary: 卡普空称，《识质存在》在发售三个月内全球销量达251万份，续作推出的可能性很高。该公司财报超出预期，旗下《生化危机》与《怪物猎人》系列也持续带动业绩。
opus_summary: 卡普空称，《识质存在》在发售三个月内全球销量达251万份，续作推出的可能性很高。该公司财报超出预期，旗下《生化危机》与《怪物猎人》系列也持续带动业绩。

paragraphs.en: Pragmata , Capcom's sci-fi adventure with an android girl sidekick, looks likely to get a sequel.
paragraphs.cn: 卡普空的科幻冒险游戏《识质存在》有一名少女型机器人搭档，看来有望推出续作。

paragraphs.en: That's according to Capcom corporate officer Yoshikazu Shimauchi, who stated that the chances of a Pragmata follow-up were high during a discussion of the company's impressive latest financial results (thanks, ).
paragraphs.cn: 卡普空企业高管Yoshikazu Shimauchi在讨论公司最新且亮眼的财报时表示，《识质存在》推出后续作品的可能性很高。

paragraphs.en: As reported yesterday , Pragmata has now shifted 2.51 million units worldwide in just three months, which is certainly a solid figure for a new franchise. Already, there had been positive noises that Pragmata might get a sequel. This latest comment from Shimauchi seems to all but confirm it.
paragraphs.cn: 正如昨日报道，《识质存在》在短短三个月内全球销量已达251万份，对一个新IP来说无疑是不错的成绩。此前已有积极迹象表明《识质存在》或将推出续作。Shimauchi的最新说法似乎几乎证实了这一点。

paragraphs.en: "We're to a point now where we’ve got another IP that Capcom — and god bless them, has an arsenal — that we can continue to go down," Capcom USA's chief operating officer Rob Dyer previously suggested , stopping short of officially confirming a sequel. Still, Dyer said that the game's lengthy six-year development time had been "worth the effort."
paragraphs.cn: 卡普空美国首席运营官Rob Dyer此前曾暗示：「我们现在又有了一个可以继续深挖的IP；卡普空手里有一整套储备，谢天谢地。」不过，他没有正式确认续作。Dyer仍表示，这款游戏长达六年的开发期「值得付出这番努力」。

paragraphs.en: Aside from Pragmata, Capcom is currently enjoying sales success across its Resident Evil and Monster Hunter franchises, with strong back catalog sales boosting profits, as well as a strong response to this year's Resident Evil Requiem. Shares in the company rose 19% following the reporting of its latest financial results, which were even more successful than expected.
paragraphs.cn: 除《识质存在》外，卡普空旗下《生化危机》和《怪物猎人》系列目前也都销量强劲；旧作销售表现出色，带动了利润增长，今年《生化危机：安魂曲》的反响同样热烈。公司公布最新财报后，股价上涨19%，而这份财报的表现甚至超出预期。

paragraphs.en: Resident Evil Requiem has now sold 8 million copies, a figure that will undoubtedly rise far further as the game gets discounted over time and receives its highly-anticipated post-launch expansion. Resident Evil 4 Remake, meanwhile, is now on an impressive 16 million copies sold. The Resident Evil 2 remake is now the best-selling Resident Evil of all time, with 19.75 million copies sold — enough to slip past Resident Evil 5's final total of 19.01 million.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机：安魂曲》目前已售出800万份；随着游戏日后降价并迎来备受期待的发售后扩展内容，这一数字无疑还会大幅攀升。与此同时，《生化危机4》重制版的销量已达亮眼的1600万份。《生化危机2》重制版则以1975万份销量成为史上最畅销的《生化危机》作品，足以超过《生化危机5》最终的1901万份。

paragraphs.en: An all-new science fiction action-adventure with its own unique hacking twist, Pragmata is set in the near future as protagonists Hugh and his android companion Diana must work together as they make their way through the cold lunar research station.
paragraphs.cn: 《识质存在》是一款全新的科幻动作冒险游戏，拥有独特的破解机制。游戏设定于近未来，主角Hugh和他的机器人同伴Diana必须携手穿行于冰冷的月球研究站。

paragraphs.en: "Punchy shooting action and a creative hacking-puzzle gameplay mechanic make combat the true highlight," we wrote in IGN's Pragmata review . "The story may seem like an afterthought, but its sci-fi drama gives enough to see it all the way through and experience this satisfying third-person shooter."
paragraphs.cn: 我们在IGN对《识质存在》的评测中写道：「短促有力的射击动作和富有创意的破解解谜机制，让战斗成为真正的亮点。故事或许看似只是附带品，但其科幻戏剧性足以让人玩到最后，完整体验这款令人满足的第三人称射击游戏。」
